title: Letter & Memo Re Mr. Jerry Remedios

page_data.en:
S.B.D. 1458.

Macau, 12 of July 1930

Director of Criminl Intelligence
Shanghai

Sir.

I will be always grateful to you if you will do me the great favour to inform me where is Mr. Jerry Remedios, clerk of Banque de L'Indo-Chine of Shanghai.

I heard that he left his job last year, but his brothers still living in Shanghai, and they will give you the information I need, if you tell them the reason.

Mr. Remadios wife elope from him two years ago aided by Augusta Graça and eldest sister of his wife, who invest money to do everything, so she can prostitute her younger sister, as she are doing in Macau, and the same sister has ruined my happiness, near by the same way, so I need Mr. Remedios to produce some important prove that I can persecute a prostitute agent.

If you succeeded in finding Mr. Remedios or his brothers please give the photo of a letter, that I am sending you by the same post, wich is the key to discover everything, and tell them that I have very important information, but they must keep very quiet now.

Trusting in your benevolence, I beg your kindness to accept my sincere thanks on anticipation, and I remain, sir, always your grateful servant.

Julia Pedruco
（签名：Julia Pedruco）
page_data.zh:
S.B.D. 1458。

澳门，1930年7月12日

致：
上海
刑事情报处处长

先生：

若您能惠予告知上海东方汇理银行（Banque de L'Indo-Chine）职员杰里·雷梅迪奥斯（Jerry Remedios）先生的下落，我将不胜感激。

我听说他去年已离职，但他的兄弟们仍居住在上海，如果您向他们说明缘由，他们会提供我所需要的信息。

雷梅迪奥斯先生的妻子于两年前在奥古斯塔·格拉萨（Augusta Graça）及其妻长姐的协助下与其私奔。后者出资操办一切，以便让其妹妹从事卖淫活动，正如她们目前在澳门所做的那样。而且，正是这位姐姐以类似的方式毁掉了我的幸福。因此，我需要雷梅迪奥斯先生提供一些重要证据，以便我对一名妓女经纪人提起诉讼。

如果您成功找到雷梅迪奥斯先生或其兄弟，请出示随本信一同寄出的信件照片，这是揭开一切真相的关键。并告诉他们，我掌握非常重要的信息，但他们目前必须保持缄默。

相信您的善意，恳请您接受我预先表达的诚挚谢意。

先生，您始终感激的仆人。

朱莉娅·佩德鲁科（Julia Pedruco）
（签名：Julia Pedruco）

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. S. B. D. 1458.
Date 21 - 7 - 30.

July 21, 30.

Madam,

I am in receipt of your letter of
July 12 together with a photograph of letter
which is returned herewith, and have to inform
you that the Police can take no action in this
matter. I would suggest that you communicate with
the Consul General for Portugal, Shanghai.
I am, Madam,

Your Obedient Servant,

[Signature]

Deputy Commissioner
(Crime & Special Branches).

Mrs. Julia Pedruco,
Rua da Restauracao No. 10
Macau.
page_data.zh:
上海工部局
刑事与特别股登记处
编号：S. B. D. 1458。
日期：1930年7月21日。

1930年7月21日。

夫人：

我已收到您7月12日的来信及所附信件照片，现随函退回该照片，并须通知您，警方对此事无法采取任何行动。建议您与葡萄牙驻上海总领事联系。

夫人，

您顺从的仆人，

[签名]

副总监
（刑事与特别股）。

朱莉娅·佩德鲁科夫人，
澳门复兴大马路10号
